valencia-group-tour.name: Valencia Group Bike Tour
valencia-group-tour.title: Valencia Group Bike Tour: Turia Gardens, Old Town & City of Arts and Sciences | Bike Tour VLC
valencia-group-tour.metaDescription: A guided 3-hour bike tour of Valencia for groups of 5–20 people. Flat approx. 12 km route: Turia Gardens, historic centre, Central Market area, City of Arts and Sciences. Bikes, helmets and guide included. Request availability.
valencia-group-tour.intro: Our main route links the green corridor of the Turia Gardens with Valencia's historic centre and the modern City of Arts and Sciences. The terrain is flat and the pace is relaxed, with regular stops.

0.name: Turia Gardens
0.text: Nine kilometres of park in the former riverbed of the Turia — the green spine of the city and the safest, calmest way to cross it by bike.

1.name: City of Arts and Sciences
1.text: Santiago Calatrava's white landmarks — the Science Museum, the Hemisfèric and the Palau de les Arts — at the gardens' eastern end.

2.name: Historic centre
2.text: Car-free lanes around the cathedral quarter, with stories from Roman Valentia to the present day.

3.name: La Lonja de la Seda
3.text: The 15th-century Silk Exchange, a UNESCO World Heritage site and one of Europe's finest Gothic civil buildings.

4.name: Central Market
4.text: One of Europe's largest covered markets, inside a Modernista hall — a look at what Valencians actually eat.

about.body1: Bike Tour VLC runs guided bike tours of Valencia for groups of 5 to 20 people. We are a small local team: we ride the same streets we guide on, and we keep groups small enough that nobody gets left at the back.

faq.title: FAQ — Group Bike Tours in Valencia | Bike Tour VLC
faq.metaDescription: Answers about group size, pricing, languages, weather, bikes and booking for guided bike tours in Valencia for groups of 5–20 people.
faq.heading: Frequently asked questions

0.q: How many people can join a tour?
0.a: Our tours are for groups of 5 to 20 people. We do not sell individual seats, and groups larger than 20 should contact us so we can discuss splitting the group across two guides.

1.q: How much does a tour cost?
1.a: Pricing depends on your group size and date. Send a booking request and we reply with the exact total for your group before anything is booked — you never pay before we confirm.

2.q: What languages do the guides speak?
2.a: We guide in English, Spanish, French and Arabic. You can choose your preferred language in the booking form.

3.a: No. Valencia is one of Europe's flattest cities, and our route follows park paths and calm streets. If you can ride a bike at a relaxed pace, you can do this tour.

4.a: If the weather makes riding unsafe or unpleasant, we work with you to reschedule. The details are in our booking terms, which you receive before confirming.

5.a: Yes. Every rider gets a city bike and a helmet, and drinking water is provided at the start.

6.q: Does requesting availability commit me to anything?
6.a: No. A request is not a reservation. We reply with availability and pricing, and only when you confirm do we reserve your guide and bikes.

7.q: Is the tour private to our group?
7.a: Depending on the date, departures may be shared between more than one group or reserved exclusively. Tell us what you prefer in your request and we will confirm what is possible.

getting-around-valencia-by-bike.title: Getting Around Valencia by Bike: A Practical Guide | Bike Tour VLC
getting-around-valencia-by-bike.metaDescription: Why Valencia is one of Spain's easiest cities to cycle: the Turia Gardens, flat terrain and a growing bike-lane network. A practical guide for visitors.
getting-around-valencia-by-bike.heading: Getting around Valencia by bike
body: Valencia is unusually kind to cyclists. The city sits on flat coastal plain, and its best-known cycling asset is the Jardí del Túria — roughly nine kilometres of gardens created in the former riverbed after the river was diverted following the 1957 flood. The park crosses the city from west to east and lets you ride from the Bioparc area to the City of Arts and Sciences almost without touching traffic.

Beyond the Turia, Valencia has been expanding its network of protected bike lanes across the centre and toward the beach neighbourhoods of Malvarrosa and El Cabanyal. The historic centre itself is largely calm, with many pedestrianised or low-traffic streets.

Practical notes: bikes are common and drivers are used to them, but the usual city caution applies at junctions. Valenbisi, the city's public bike-share, is aimed at residents and short trips; visitors staying several days can also rent from local shops. Summer midday heat is real — ride in the morning or late afternoon, and carry water.
If you are visiting as a group of five or more, a guided tour is the low-friction option: route, bikes, helmets and timing are handled for you.

group-bike-tour-planning.title: How to Plan a Group Bike Tour in Valencia | Bike Tour VLC
group-bike-tour-planning.metaDescription: Dates, group sizes, languages, fitness levels and timing — a practical checklist for organising a guided bike tour in Valencia for a group of 5–20 people.
group-bike-tour-planning.heading: How to plan a group bike tour in Valencia
body: A group bike tour is one of the easiest ways to see Valencia together — but a little planning makes the day much smoother. Start with your date and rough group size; most operators, us included, plan tours around groups rather than fixed public departures.

Group size matters. Tours like ours are designed for 5 to 20 people: below five, guiding economics rarely work; above twenty, the group gets hard to keep together at junctions. If your party is larger, ask about splitting across two guides.
Think about the slowest rider. Valencia is flat, which helps enormously, but agree a relaxed pace expectation up front. A good guide rides at the back-marker's speed, not the front-runner's.
Pick a language. If your group is mixed, say so in your request — guiding in English, Spanish, French and Arabic is standard for us.
Finally, book a few days ahead where you can. Requests are free and non-binding, so there is no downside to asking early.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy | Bike Tour VLC
privacy.metaDescription: How Bike Tour VLC handles personal data from booking requests and contact messages.
privacy.heading: Privacy policy

data.title: What we collect
data.text: When you send a booking request or contact message we store the details you provide: name, email, optional phone number, group size, preferred date and language, and your message. We use this only to answer you and organise your tour.

use.title: How we use it
use.text: Your data is used to respond to your request, confirm availability and pricing, and manage the tour. We do not sell data, we do not send marketing email without your consent, and we do not send your personal form data to analytics tools.

retention.title: Storage and retention
retention.text: Booking requests are stored on our hosting provider's infrastructure within the EU/EEA or under appropriate safeguards. We keep requests as long as needed to handle your booking and meet legal obligations.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.text: Under the GDPR you can request access, correction or deletion of your personal data at any time via the contact page. You can also complain to the Spanish data protection authority (AEPD).

review.title: Status of this policy
review.text: This policy is a working draft prepared for launch. The operator's legal identity and final data-processing details must be confirmed before the site goes live.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy | Bike Tour VLC
cookies.metaDescription: Cookie policy for Bike Tour VLC: strictly necessary storage only, no tracking without consent.
cookies.heading: Cookie policy

necessary.title: What this site uses
necessary.text: This website works without tracking cookies. We use only technically necessary storage required to deliver the pages you request.

analytics.title: Analytics and consent
analytics.text: If we enable privacy-respecting analytics in the future, non-essential measurement will only run after you give consent, and you will be able to change your choice. Personal form data is never sent to analytics.

manage.title: Managing cookies
manage.text: You can delete or block cookies in your browser settings at any time without affecting the booking request form.
